name: spec-orchestrate
description: Run spec-driven development entirely inside Claude Code, autonomously from propose to commit — Claude is both the global commander (propose, per-stage review gates, runtime verification, archive, selective commit; no approval waits, stops only on real blockers) and the executor (small changes on the main thread; multi-phase changes via one executor subagent per change, continued with SendMessage). Auto-detects spectra or openspec.
